name: LayerNormGrad
note: adv_api/normalization/layernormgrad.h. Backward of LayerNorm with two outputs (outputPdX, resForGamma). 3510 impl reads tiling.{stackBufferSize,bLength,sLength,hLength,lastDimValueBack,lastDimValueBackMulTwo}; the last two are 1/H and 2/H stored as float bit-patterns in uint32 fields. Verifiable case: dy=0 -> x1=dy*gamma=0 -> pdVar=pdMean=0 -> outputPdX=0; x=mean=5 -> x2=0 -> resForGamma=(x-mean)*rstd=0. Both outputs 0.
